senses.gloss: (cmp. preced. a. Arab. דכס in Wahrmund Arab. Handwörterbuch) to crush, weaken. Y’lamd. to Gen. XXIV, 1 quot. in Ar. (חולי דוכסן) חלי דכסן read דְּכָסוֹ or דִּיכְּסוֹ disease broke his energies (I Kings XI, 4).
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 5">Gen. R. s. 5</cite>, v. <cite ref="D00790"><he>דִּכְסָס</he></cite>.
